page.overview:
Who is Miss Catherina?

Miss Catherina is a former Baroque Works Millions agent who was stationed at Whisky Peak alongside her partner, Mr. Beans. She worked under the Frontier Agents Mr. 8, Miss Monday, Mr. 9, and Miss Wednesday.

Miss Catherina is a young woman that dressed in a religious habit typical of a nun. She wears a long black dress with long sleeves and a veal that covers her hair. In the Egghead Arc and live-action series, her hair is slightly visible and shown to be black. She also carries around a cross that she wears around her neck using a necklace.

Miss Catherina is sly and deceitful as she pretended to be an average nun while welcoming the Straw Hat Pirates, whereas, in reality, she was actually a bounty hunter that was trying to trick them into letting off their guard. Furthermore, she also displayed her deceitful nature when she tried to trick Roronoa Zoro into believing that she was actually asking for mercy during their fight but was, instead, actually seeking to surprise attack him.

Miss Catherina's partner was Mr. Beans. Together, they deceived their enemies into believing that they were an innocent nun and child duo, and would then attack them while their enemies let their guard down.
